installed_package_tests.source: R CMD check --as-cran installed-package test run

source_tests.description: Only golden allocation/incomplete snapshots fail. Their generated .new snapshot files are byte-for-byte identical to those from unmodified base commit on this Linux machine. Other source tests pass. No unrelated reference snapshots were updated.

final_focused_tests: diagonal_spacing, diagonal_optimization, golden-unreplicated: pass with FIELDHUB_GOLDEN=true after correcting the source Unicode literal to an equivalent ASCII escape.
compatibility: Six complete fixed-seed results are identical to base after removing only the added check_spacing component, including off/on, multiple locations and both metrics.
browser: Existing generic Single Diagonal page shows OFF and ON reports after Run! then Randomize!, with no displayed errors. App controls remain frozen by Run!; changing optimization requires pressing Run! again.

check_corrected_source.note: HTML validation skipped because system HTML Tidy is unavailable. Tests were run separately above; the final check does not repeat them.
